title: render the intro film
summary: `intro-film/screenplay.json` → `intro-film/out/intro.mp4`: the ~67-second encode. No approval check here on purpose — rendering is how the owner GETS a film to watch, and gating it behind approval deadlocked the review. The approval gate (150) is enforced in code at assembly (`requireIntroApproved()` in lib/assemble.mjs), not by refusing to render.
